headline: Senate clears the deck on tax relief for abuse survivors as House powers up nuclear energy trio!

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate voted 73-25 to advance debate on H.R. 2347, the Survivor Justice Tax Prevention Act, clearing a cloture hurdle. The chamber also passed the RISE Act to help students with disabilities navigate college selection and enrollment, and authorized use of the Hart Senate Office Building atrium for an art installation on November 18. A unanimous consent agreement was reached to consider H. Con. Res. 93 on war powers and Iran hostilities by November 20.

onTheFloor.title: Survivor Justice Tax Prevention Act—excludes non-punitive damages from sexual abuse from gross income; legislative vehicle for Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act
onTheFloor.status: Cloture vote passed 73-25, post-cloture consideration continuing Tuesday

onTheFloor.title: RISE Act—provides students with disabilities and families access to information for college selection and success
Authorization for use of Hart Senate Office Building atrium for Alexander Calder sculpture commemoration and reunification
War Powers Resolution directing removal of U.S. Armed Forces from hostilities with Iran
onTheFloor.status: Discharged by November 20 with 6 hours debate

house.lastSessionSummary: The House passed five major nuclear energy bills under suspension of the rules with overwhelming bipartisan support, including the Nuclear REFUEL Act (397-2), American Enrichment Deployment Act (394-3), and supporting measures for reactor oversight and NRC staff compensation. The chamber also voted to increase veterans' disability compensation effective December 1, 2026. Two additional nuclear licensing bills saw debate postponed.

onTheFloor.title: Nuclear REFUEL Act—updates definition of production facility to exclude certain spent nuclear fuel reprocessing equipment
American Enrichment Deployment Act—updates licensing procedures for uranium enrichment facilities
Nuclear Advisory Committee Reform Act—updates role of Advisory Committee on Reactor Safeguards
NRC Staff Pay Alignment Act—provides compensation authority for career appointees
Veterans' Compensation Cost-of-Living Adjustment Act of 2026—increases disability and survivor compensation effective December 1
Retirement Fairness for Charities and Educational Institutions Act—enhances 403(b) retirement plans
